provenance.boundary: Native ObjectStroke NewApplyBinary receives the reconstructed original object payload and StringID table, then native ObjectDrawing::drawObjectStroke executes GLV14 RedrawPen and captures RTV4 AddPoint callback arguments. This fixture stops at the complete six-float callback stream: it does not execute RTV4 SendDataToGPU/Update/Draw. The 1920 control changes both the explicit NewApply width and IContext width, so it is a combined control, not an isolated argument-only comparison. No Samsung SDK outer page-loader or device raster claim.
provenance.host_adapters: Pinned caller adapters provide IContext/CanvasProbe, task queue dispatch, allocator, and synthetic dlopen/dlsym handles for the already pinned FountainPen and DefaultPen DSOs.
